_note: Suggestions for the tagger's Neighborhoods mode. A hint proposes a run starting at an IMG number and carries the evidence in the frame that produced it. Hints are NEVER applied automatically — they render as dashed amber bands you accept or ignore. A hint may propose a city (small towns), a neighborhood (districts of a big city), or both. Placing a town in the neighborhood field would render 'Vicksburg, Mississippi Delta, MS' and deny it a place page, so towns are proposed as CITIES.
